title: AS2MessageConnectionSettings
description: The AS2 agreement message connection settings.

ignoreCertificateNameMismatch.description: The value indicating whether to ignore mismatch in certificate name.

keepHttpConnectionAlive.description: The value indicating whether to keep the connection alive.

supportHttpStatusCodeContinue.description: The value indicating whether to support HTTP status code 'CONTINUE'.

unfoldHttpHeaders.description: The value indicating whether to unfold the HTTP headers.
